name: Allied
note: Combined Allied headquarters that belong to no single nation, for example SHAEF and AFHQ (folder allied; no claim files yet). Kept as an explicit value; the unit records do not say which nation staffed them.

name: Australia
note: Australian formations (folder australia). Added 15 November 2026 for the Normandy air and naval pass (RAAF squadrons such as 453; HMAS ships); no unit yet.

name: France
note: Free French and French Army formations (folder france).

name: Germany
note: Germany, including Waffen-SS and Luftwaffe ground formations (folder germany). The unit id prefix is GER; the nationality value is Germany; the adjective used in names is German.

name: Norway
note: Norwegian formations (folder norway). Added 15 November 2026 for the Normandy air and naval pass (331 and 332 Squadrons; Norwegian-flag ships); no unit yet.

name: New Zealand
note: New Zealand formations (folder new_zealand). Added 15 November 2026 for the Normandy air and naval pass (RNZAF squadrons such as 485; no unit yet). The adjective is the country name as written in the sources.

name: Poland
note: Polish formations serving under British or Allied command (folder poland).

name: South Africa
note: South African formations (folder south_africa). Added 15 November 2026 for the Normandy air and naval pass (SAAF and South African Naval Forces; no unit yet).

name: UK
note: United Kingdom and Commonwealth formations serving in British armies except those with their own entry (folder uk).
